objective: Protect people and restore trust after fatal product tampering.
businessContext: Externally tampered capsules caused deaths and a national trust crisis.
strategy: Put public safety first through broad recall, transparent communication and tamper-resistant packaging.
outcomes: The response became a widely studied crisis-management precedent and accelerated packaging safeguards.
whatWorked: Actions matched the stated priority of public safety.
failureModes: copying crisis language without equivalent action
transferConditions: Leadership can act quickly, accept short-term cost and provide verifiable remediation.
nonTransferConditions: Do not treat transparency as messaging alone when operational harm remains unresolved.
